description: Creates a named room before anyone joins; users can enter it even when the app does not let them create rooms. Fails if the name exists; LOBBY is reserved. Change it with neblla_update_room, delete it with neblla_delete_room.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

permanent.description: true keeps the room's data when it empties; otherwise the data resets.

ttlInactivity.description: Days without activity before Neblla deletes the room, 0-3650 (0 = never); left out, the app's value for public rooms.

name: neblla_create_room
title: Create a room
